entities.description: A wooden desk with a smooth, polished surface and visible wood grain patterns in shades of brown. On the desk, there is a tablet with a black screen and a silver frame, a clipboard with a white sheet of paper and a pen resting on it, and a person's hands writing on the paper. The person is wearing a dark-colored shirt, and another person's arm is visible on the left side, wearing a light blue shirt. The desk appears to be in a professional or office setting.

A woman with curly red hair is seated at a wooden table, wearing a dark blue V-neck scrub top and holding a silver pen in her right hand while writing on a clipboard. She is looking upward and to the left with a focused expression, while a person in light blue scrubs with a stethoscope stands behind her holding another clipboard.

A young man with curly brown hair and light skin is seated at a wooden table, wearing light blue medical scrubs and gesturing with both hands while speaking. He wears a black hair tie on his left wrist and a black watch on his right wrist, with a tablet lying on the table in front of him.
